gloss: to push out, to force out

definitions.gloss: to push out, to force out
definitions.explanation: To push something or someone out from a place.
To push out a substance from a container.

examples.japanese: {競争|きょうそう}から{押|お}し{出|だ}された。
examples.english: I was pushed out of the competition.

examples.japanese: {勇気|ゆうき}を{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}って{一歩|いっぽ}{押|お}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I summon my courage and push forward a step.

examples.japanese: {群衆|ぐんしゅう}に{押|お}し{出|だ}されて{前|まえ}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I was pushed forward by the crowd.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}が{古|ふる}い{商品|しょうひん}を{市場|しじょう}から{押|お}し{出|だ}した。
examples.english: New products pushed old products out of the market.

examples.japanese: {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}を{押|お}し{出|だ}す。
チューブからクリームを{押|お}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To squeeze cream out of a tube.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}が{製品|せいひん}を{型|かた}から{押|お}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The machine pushes the product out of the mold.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}まで{押|お}し{出|だ}して{使|つか}い{切|き}った。
examples.english: I squeezed it all the way out and used it up.

examples.japanese: {粘土|ねんど}を{機械|きかい}で{押|お}し{出|だ}して、{細|ほそ}い{棒|ぼう}の{形|かたち}にする。
examples.english: The clay is extruded by machine into thin rod shapes.

notes:
{押|お}し{出|だ}す means to push something outward or squeeze out a substance.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle for the thing being pushed out

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {押|お}す (to push) + {出|だ}す (to put out, to begin).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}を{押|お}し{出|だ}す: squeeze out toothpaste
- {市場|しじょう}から{押|お}し{出|だ}される: be pushed out of the market
- {前|まえ}に{押|お}し{出|だ}す: push forward

ASPECT (ている):
{押|お}し{出|だ}している indicates the action is ongoing or habitual.

NOTE:
In baseball, {押|お}し{出|だ}し refers to a "walk with bases loaded" (scoring a run by walking a batter).
